purpose: Prepare a private, bilingual, non-promotable cognitive-interview operations kit for the frozen six-card CMLE comprehension instrument without collecting, simulating as human, or claiming any participant outcome.

assignment_contract.design: Within each language, use the complete set of ten unordered pairs among five analytical cases exactly once.
assignment_contract.case_exposure: Each case appears four times per language, twice first and twice second.
assignment_contract.experience_strata: Five novice-target and five experienced-target slots per language; a five-cycle and its complement give each case two exposures in each stratum.
assignment_contract.language_parity: English and Japanese use the same pair, order, stratum, and task-position codes.
assignment_contract.interpretation: This deterministic allocation balances the planned template; it does not randomize recruited people or guarantee sample comparability.

session_contract.duration: Target 60-90 minutes including consent, two scenarios, retrospective probes, and debrief; stop for burden or withdrawal.
sequence: Confirm applicable ethics/privacy/consent approval before recruitment.
Assign the next eligible private SessionSlotId without recording name or email in the analytical record.
Present the frozen preview and collect an unaided response before any probe or correction.
Use standardized retrospective probes only after the response is locked.
Record paraphrased, PII-reviewed observations and controlled issue codes; keep any contact roster outside this kit.
Honor withdrawal without deleting the attempted-session audit row; exclude withdrawn content from analysis under the approved protocol.
Do not calculate or publish a comprehension pass rate from formative interviews.
session_contract.coaching_rule: No clarification of CMLE, WLE, MnSq, anchor validity, calibration uncertainty, public sharing, or correct status is permitted before the participant locks the response.
session_contract.revision_rule: Every wording or layout change creates a new InstrumentVersion; never pool pre- and post-revision responses as one instrument.

privacy_contract.allowed_identity: SessionSlotId only; it is a schedule slot, not a participant identifier.
privacy_contract.record_schema: Exact allowlisted columns only; unexpected columns fail closed.
privacy_contract.qualitative_notes: Only paraphrased observations are allowed, and any non-empty note requires PIIReviewed=true before validation.
privacy_contract.separation: Recruitment/contact records, consent documents, raw recordings, and operational correspondence remain outside this analytical kit under separately approved access and retention controls.
privacy_contract.withdrawal: Withdrawal status is retained in the attempt ledger, while content handling follows the approved consent/protocol.

issue_taxonomy.critical_meaning: A plausible path to one of the six registered dangerous misconceptions or an inability to distinguish blocked/not-run/withheld states.
issue_taxonomy.analysis_policy: Retain issue counts and disposition by item, case, language, stratum, and instrument version; do not convert formative codes into population rates.

packet_separation.participant_packet: Contains only assigned previews/tasks, response option codes, and SessionSlotId; never correct options, rationales, criticality, misconception codes, or moderator probes.
packet_separation.moderator_guide: Private file containing standardized post-response probes, rationale, criticality, and escalation reminders.
packet_separation.record_template: Contains empty operational response/observation fields and no human values at generation time.
packet_separation.answer_leakage: Any researcher-only field in a participant packet fails the contract.

synthetic_validation.meaning: Synthetic records test validators only and are never labelled participants or used for comprehension claims.

automated_success_gates.identity: All parent hashes match before execution.
automated_success_gates.schedule: Forty assignment rows cover 20 slots with the registered pair, order, stratum, case-exposure, and language-parity balance.
automated_success_gates.participant_packets: Twenty private session packets contain 400 assigned task rows, exactly 20 per slot, with no researcher-only fields.
automated_success_gates.moderator_guide: The private guide covers all 100 case-language-item identities with post-response probes and controlled severity guidance.
automated_success_gates.record_template: The blank 400-row record template matches schedule assignments and contains zero responses, notes, issue codes, timings, confidence values, or human identifiers.
automated_success_gates.privacy: Exact-column validation rejects every registered forbidden or unexpected field and requires reviewed paraphrase status.
automated_success_gates.synthetic_validator: Every registered accepted/rejected synthetic mutation reaches its expected typed state.
automated_success_gates.human_gate: HumanStudyStatus remains not_started_no_human_data, HumanParticipants=0, and PublicSurfaceEnabled=false.
automated_success_gates.tests: New operations tests plus the selected comprehension/one-click/archive suites pass.

interpretation_limits.balance: Balanced schedule templates do not eliminate recruitment, language-proficiency, moderator, learning, order, or attrition bias.
interpretation_limits.formative: Cognitive interviews diagnose instrument problems; they do not estimate comprehension prevalence or qualify the UI.
interpretation_limits.ethics: This repository template is not ethics approval, consent language, legal advice, or institutional authorization.
interpretation_limits.accessibility: Moderator coding cannot replace real-browser, keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, or other assistive-technology testing.
interpretation_limits.next_gate: After approved recruitment and bilingual cognitive interviews, register every revision, freeze a new instrument, and only then run the separately registered pilot.
